title: Cardinal of Como (papal Secretariat) to Anselmo Dandini, nuncio in France, 1580 (ASV Segr. Stato Francia 283C, DECODE R72-R73)

steps.what: DECODE R72-R73 metadata, 4 page images, 11 DOC images and 6 DOC text files fetched with the session cookie; Lasry's key and his R73 decryption found on the records.
Lasry's reconstructed key applied to the R72 transcription (DP parse). Parse fits the frame (only code 38 unknown) but the letters are nonsense: different letter assignment.
Homophonic annealing on a naive 2-digit tokenisation of R72. Free assignment collapsed to a constant string; fixed-multiset swaps did not converge (misaligned tokens).

Swap annealing of letter values on the DP parse, nomenclator words fixed as plaintext, Italian 4-grams from it-renaissance. Readable Italian at once: 'la voce et l'opinione della pratica ... con la monaca e uscita tanto publica'.
Clear block at the foot of f. 52 transcribed and recognised as the contemporary decipherment; decryption aligned with it, three codes corrected (22 l, 62 e, 72 i).

outcome.method_basis: R72 has its contemporary decipherment written out below the figures on f. 52, and R73 was already decrypted by Lasry on DECODE (D3191, key D3190, 2020); the project transcribed and checked these, and separately rebuilt R72's different letter key by annealing inside Lasry's frame and nomenclator, corrected against the leaf's decipherment.
outcome.notes: R72 read (contemporary decipherment confirmed by the recovered key); R73 read by Lasry, 32 illegible groups and 5 nomenclator groups open.

prior.where: R72: contemporary decipherment on the leaf. R73: Lasry's decryption and key on DECODE (Oct 2020).

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.
